@section l35-04 | Unit 4 | Vocabulary practice · Unit 4 | 文意字彙・選擇題・配合題
@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The scandal completely destroyed the mayor's reputation and ended his political c______r.
= career
~詞義 career（n.）職涯
~原文 The scandal completely destroyed the mayor's reputation and ended his political career.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Last year, Albert took the o______y to travel abroad with his uncle.
= opportunity
~詞義 opportunity（n.）機會
~原文 Last year, Albert took the opportunity to travel abroad with his uncle.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: My dog loves it when I rub his ears gently. He always licks my hand to r______d me not to stop.
= remind
~詞義 remind（v.）提醒
~原文 My dog loves it when I rub his ears gently. He always licks my hand to remind me not to stop.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Dr. Lin's medical ______ (practical) serves both local residents and patients from nearby towns.
= practice
~詞義 practice（n.）診所
~原文 Dr. Lin's medical practice serves both local residents and patients from nearby towns.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: After years in the cold north, Jean dreamed of retiring to the ______ (tropical) to enjoy the warm sunshine and gentle sea breezes.
= tropics
~詞義 tropics（n.）熱帶地區
~原文 After years in the cold north, Jean dreamed of retiring to the tropics to enjoy the warm sunshine and gentle sea breezes.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: When Victor teaches English, he always entertains his students with ______ stories.
A: trendy
B: practical
C: steady
D: vivid
= D
~詞義 vivid（adj.）生動的;栩栩如生的
~原文 When Victor teaches English, he always entertains his students with vivid stories.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The two men ______ business cards before sitting down to negotiate the contract.
A: responded
B: concealed
C: exchanged
D: signaled
= C
~詞義 exchange（v.）交換
~原文 The two men exchanged business cards before sitting down to negotiate the contract.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: It was ______ of Oscar to leave the campfire burning because it could easily spread and cause a forest fire.
A: specific
B: temporary
C: irresponsible
D: previous
= C
~詞義 irresponsible（adj.）不負責任的
~原文 It was irresponsible of Oscar to leave the campfire burning because it could easily spread and cause a forest fire.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The teacher ______ her students that they were not allowed to use their smartphones in class.
A: warned
B: rated
C: stripped
D: concealed
= A
~詞義 warn（v.）警告
~原文 The teacher warned her students that they were not allowed to use their smartphones in class.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Albert Einstein was a famous physicist from the 20th century who developed the ______ of relativity.
A: signal
B: theory
C: emergency
D: decade
= B
~詞義 theory（n.）理論
~原文 Albert Einstein was a famous physicist from the 20th century who developed the theory of relativity.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: capture
B: specific
C: steady
D: decay
E: rate
F: statue

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Without ______ facts or examples, the article is not successful in proving its point.
= B
~詞義 specific（adj.）明確的
~原文 Without specific facts or examples, the article is not successful in proving its point.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ of Liberty is a major tourist attraction. Few go to New York City without visiting it.
= F
~詞義 statue（n.）雕像
~原文 The statue of Liberty is a major tourist attraction. Few go to New York City without visiting it.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The policemen tried to ______ the robber but failed.
= A
~詞義 capture（v.）逮捕
~原文 The policemen tried to capture the robber but failed.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Large numbers of refugees from the Middle East found their way into Western Europe in the hope of finding safe living conditions and ______ employment.
= C
~詞義 steady（adj.）穩定的
~原文 Large numbers of refugees from the Middle East found their way into Western Europe in the hope of finding safe living conditions and steady employment.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: At 9.2%, the unemployment ______ has risen to its highest point in history.
= E
~詞義 rate（n.）比率
~原文 At 9.2%, the unemployment rate has risen to its highest point in history.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: savings
B: signal
C: previous
D: temporary
E: emergency
F: staff

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Today's teenagers are quite different from teens in ______ decades.
= C
~詞義 previous（adj.）之前的
~原文 Today's teenagers are quite different from teens in previous decades.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The hospital had to ______ the wards with extra nurses after the sudden outbreak of flu cases.
= F
~詞義 staff（v.）為…配置組員
~原文 The hospital had to staff the wards with extra nurses after the sudden outbreak of flu cases.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Many people work ______ jobs until they decide what kind of jobs they really want.
= D
~詞義 temporary（adj.）暫時的
~原文 Many people work temporary jobs until they decide what kind of jobs they really want.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The firefighter stays calm whenever he faces a(n) ______ situation.
= E
~詞義 emergency（n.）緊急情況
~原文 The firefighter stays calm whenever he faces a(n) emergency situation.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The father's long-term disease led the family to spend all of their ______.
= A
~詞義 savings（n.）存款
~原文 The father's long-term disease led the family to spend all of their savings.
